about: The clean variant: the base project after the reviewer has released every held row, so the release gate refuses nothing (the two critical secrets nobody had decided get a decision too) and the export panel shows its Export button. Each held row of the base variant gets the decision a reviewer would give it (the row the engine merged gets a recorded merge), and the Engine Check No on sql-11 is given its correction (the verdict is posted again with the correction named, replacing the uncorrected one).
